response.sql:
WITH film_copies AS (
  SELECT 
    f.film_id,
    f.rating,
    COUNT(*) as copies
  FROM film f
  JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating
)
SELECT 
  fc.film_id,
  fc.rating,
  fc.copies,
  fc.copies - AVG(fc.copies) OVER (PARTITION BY fc.rating) as diff_from_rating_avg,
  fc.copies - AVG(fc.copies) OVER () as diff_from_overall_avg
FROM film_copies fc
ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "Overall average copy count per film" means the arithmetic mean of copy counts across all individual films with inventory (not the average of rating group averages), consistent with the parenthetical clarification "averaged over the individual films, not over the rating averages."
